name: bums.showdown.w1-b.name
authorNotes: Showdown / survive, 2-4 players, enclosed single-screen arena (no split-screen camera needed, §5). All four spawn together on the base island; the 'tide' hazard is a crusher shaped as a rising wall, its path climbing from y1300 (below the island) to y150 (above the top perch) at 15.3px/s — a ~75s rise from base to summit, matching §8.2's 'closing lethal boundary forces an end within 75s'. Note for the engine ticket: the Hazard contract has no time-varying shape/size field, only a static Shape plus a kinematic path, so 'closing boundary' is approximated here as one large hazard translating upward rather than a true shrinking radius — flagging this the same way as w1-09's crane, since both hit the same schema gap. Players retreat upward via swing-survive-mid then swing-survive-top as the tide climbs; the top perch is the last refuge and holds only one comfortably, which is the point. relic-w1-b sits on the top perch as a risk/reward pickup for the haul objective. A static void strip under the base island punishes anyone knocked clean off before the tide even arrives.
